The '''Stalton Syndicate''' was a criminal organization in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They once extorting [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Ten merchants formed the [[Committee for Renewal]] and hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to stop the syndicate.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
